notes.title: Update Notes for V1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Gamers![/b]

I'm pleased to announce that the [b]2nd Update[/b] of Loss is officially live! This is a [b]BIG[/b] Update that adds some exciting new features, like a [b]Speedrun Mode[/b], a new[b] Hints System[/b] and... a [b]Secret Ending[/b]? Let's take a look!


[h1]Speedrun Mode[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125848/f87ea99d08ea8373442c76e7a7479a6385b0f69d.png[/img]

- Now in the Title Screen and/or Pause Menu, you can enable a [b]Speedrun timer[/b] that will show up throughout your entire playthrough in the bottom left corner of the screen (above your Health Bar).
- When you finish the game, a new Menu will appear showing your time in that attempt and your best time ever. This is perfect for Speedrunning the game! There is officially now a Category of "Loss" in https://www.speedrun.com/Loss if you want to submit your run. Give it a try!


[h1]Hints System[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125848/dc26fec9de3f2f0da6df5a0433ff5d8b19b8e6e0.png[/img]

- I noticed that some puzzles were pretty hard to figure out for newcomers, so after some consideration, I decided to add a [b]Hints System[/b] to the game! 
- At any time, you can access the Pause Menu and press the button with a Light Bulb. This will give you a text hint on how to solve your current puzzle. New hints will appear once you enter a room with a new puzzle. This system isn't perfect, but it will hopefully solve any frustrations you might have felt while solving a puzzle.
- I still [b]HIGHLY[/b] recommend that you try to solve the puzzles on your own! They are not that hard, and it will be way more rewarding without any help. Good luck ;)


[h1]Secret Ending...[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125848/8eb3511b6f7da4e37da5d1cbfa71e160fbe983b9.png[/img]

- I added a [b]second ending[/b] to the game! A few people requested that I added an optional 2nd conclusion to Loss's story, so I decided to add it! You'll have to solve a puzzle first, I'll let you figure it out on your own...
- A new [b]Achievement[/b] was added for this ending. If you want to 100% the game, you'll have to unlock the secret ending as well.


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the Save System wasn't saving the Easter Eggs you've already found
[*]Fixed an issue where the player would be stuck outside the living room in Floor 0 if he managed to activate the second Boss from the corridor. Now the player teleports inside the room.
[*]Additional bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

And that's all! These were features that I was already planning to add to "Loss", but I needed a few more days to develop everything. I really want this to be the best experience possible, and I hope you'll have as much fun playing it as I did working on it! I don't have any other big Updates in mind, so this will probably be the last "Major" update to the game. Thanks for reading until here, and have fun trying the new features!

notes.title: Update Notes for V1.0.1 (May 24th, 2025)
notes.content:
[b]Greeting, Gamers![/b]

I'm pleased to announce that the [b]1st Update[/b] of Loss is officially live! This is a smaller Patch meant to fix a few bugs and also improve the overall clarity of the game. A larger Update will be releasing soon!

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Decreased the difficulty of the first Boss by increasing its stunned duration and by making the boss enemies a bit slower and easier to kill
[*]Reduced the number of times the lights go off in Floor 1
[*]Reduced the health of the third Boss so it's a bit easier to kill
[*]Added a [b]"Darker Mode"[/b] setting that, when turned off, will make the game a bit brighter. This improves the visibility of the game significantly. The default setting is on
[*]Changed the position of a few items, so they're easier to find
[*]Added a small table in the Attic and placed the lamp on top of it, so it is easier to find when fighting the first Boss
[*]Fixed an issue with the lights that, when the Quality was set to Medium or Low, would flicker if you looked away from them
[*]Fixed an issue where the first Ghost Enemies would still attack you if you were near a lamp
[*]Fixed an issue where sometimes the enemy in the office would be able to attack the player through the wall
[*]Fixed an issue in Floor 0 where the the piano Sheets would disappear below the carpet if you dropped them
[*]Fixed an issue where the "Crouch to make less noise" tutorial in Floor 0 would still appear when you died and restarted
[*]Fixed an issue where the pan in the kitchen would have its cap in the wrong place when you picked it up
[*]Fixed an issue where the enemies in Floor 0 will chase you and then disappear if you didn't move after activating the first custscene
[*]Fixed an issue where the UI of the Player would still be visible in the End Screen
[*]Changed the text in the [spoiler]laser gun tutorial[/spoiler] so that it is more clear that you need to use it to defeat the enemies
[*]Fixed an issue with the third boss where he would start [spoiler]his sword swing attack while you were near a tree branch[/spoiler]
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to the "Loss" Community!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Steam Users,[/b]

It seems that for some weird reason Steam recommended my game for you, so let me introduce myself. I'm SimonStache, the solo developer of "Loss", and I've been working on this game for the past year or so. This is just a "welcome!" post to start the discussions of my game. I would love it if you [b]joined the community![/b] Feel free to share your thoughts and be nice :)
